h: Ha’azinu Sings of Return Within the Story of Exile

p: "Though I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
I will fear no harm, for You are with me;
This parshah is called a song,
"And now write for yourselves this song."
And a song is said over a miracle,
כְּמוֹ אָז יָשִׁיר מֹשֶׁה (שְׁמוֹת טו, א)
that are enumerated in the Midrash
(Tanchuma Beshalach, and in the Mechilta there)
וְכֵן אָמְרוּ חֲזַ״ל (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה שְׁמוֹת פָּרָשָׁה כג)
"All the songs are in the feminine," etc.;
כָּךְ הֵן הַצָּרוֹת בָּאוֹת עֲלֵיהֶן וְכוּלֵּי
"so the troubles come upon them," etc.;
there are no more troubles," etc.;
they say shir, in the masculine."
are over miracles and rescues from troubles.
there is praise of the Exodus from Egypt
and their entry into Eretz Yisrael;
but afterward there is in it
of the pain of the exiles,
and a lament for people of heart;
so why is this a song?
אַךְ מִמַּה שֶּׁהֵעִיד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל (שָׁם לא, כט)
But from His testifying regarding Yisrael (Devarim 31:29),
מִזֶּה יֵשׁ עַל כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל זְכוּת
from this there is merit for Klal Yisrael,
that they would corrupt their way.
וּכְבָר שָׁאַל הָרַמְבַּ״ם זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה (הִלְכוֹת תְּשׁוּבָה)
And the Rambam, of blessed memory, already asked (Hilchos Teshuvah)
why, it was a decree from before Him, may He be blessed!
שֶׁלֹּא פֵּרַט הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֵׁם אוּמָּה
that Hashem Yisbarach did not specify the name of the nation,
and by their own choice they chose
to be the enslavers and oppressors.
where the name of the nation Yisrael was specified,
that they would corrupt their way,
if it had not been so,
it would almost have been a desecration of the Name of Heaven,
that something was written in the Torah
that is not true, chas v'shalom.
And although this is no answer
regarding the individual souls of Yisrael,
regarding the community as a whole
it comes out to teach merit.
וְזֶה אִם יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים (יְשַׁעְיָה א, יח)
And this is "If your sins be like the years" (Yeshayahu 1:18),
that come in order from the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow."
And since such was the order,
that they would corrupt their way
and afterward return and be redeemed;
and just as Hashem Yisbarach chose
to write the sin of Bas Sheva
about David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
and that he would rectify it through teshuvah,
אַף שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה רָאוּי לְאוֹתוֹ מַעֲשֶׂה
although he was not suited to that deed
כֵּן הָיָה הָרָצוֹן עַל כְּלַל הָאוּמָּה
so was the will regarding the nation as a whole,
that such would be the order,
until they rectify it through teshuvah,
And therefore this parshah is read
when the goat is sent off,
"and it shall carry all their sins,"
וְזֶהוּ שֶׁאָמַר דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is what David HaMelech, peace be upon him, said:
"Though I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,

The Foretold Return Gives Hope for the Community
